title: Decision contribution vocabulary (proposed under TDR-0049)
description: The machine-readable form of records/decision/specification/decision-contribution.md, which defines every term here. It validates the classification of one fragment's contribution to a consequential decision, and its $defs are the vocabulary itself: the classes, the classes reported as findings, the five canonical reasons something is not a decision, the kinds of evidence that no decision was made, and the roles historical recovery treats specially. Consumers read the vocabulary from here rather than restating it. Not a record schema.

taxonomy_version.description: The version of this vocabulary. Equal to the specification's.

concerns.description: The candidate, or the fragment of the act, an applicability or persistence finding concerns.

continuation_authority.description: Whether an act authorising the arrangement beyond its stated term is evidenced. Continued operation is never that evidence.

finding_classes.description: Classes reported as findings in the recovery report, by fragment. Never a contribution inside a candidate.

not_a_decision_reason.description: Stable identifiers for the five reasons something resembling a decision is not one.

non_decision_kind.description: Evidence that no decision was made — distinct from no decision being evidenced.

event_role.description: The role a historical candidate's event_time_ref points at.

context_roles.description: Roles graded for contemporaneity and annotated with `considered`: what was known, and the evidence considered, at the time.

never_inferred_roles.description: Roles and classes a contribution may fill only with derivation `explicit`: who acted, under what authority, instead of what.

invocation_roles.description: Roles and classes a contribution may fill only from material made in the act, or shown to have been before whoever acted — never from unlinked or retrospective material. An instrument the act does not cite supports applicability, a finding.
